scope.method: Questions and gold facts hand-authored from direct readings of normalized retained source documents, before running retrieval. No search ranking or generated answer used to select gold.
scope.evidence_status: Publisher statements in retained source snapshots; not independently reproduced facts, audiovisual review or semantic review of every corpus document.
scope.literal_quotes: At most 12 whitespace-delimited words per anchor and 25 total quoted words per source across all cases, counting repeated anchors again.
scope.gold_scope: Expected source IDs are known relevant documents, not exhaustive relevance judgments. Alternative valid sources may exist. These fixed questions are a diagnostic development set, not an independently held-out randomized sample.
scope.unsupported_cases: Partial and not_established cases still have relevant context sources. Document/span hits measure context retrieval only and do not establish a supported conclusion, abstention quality or answer faithfulness. Required unknowns must stay explicit in manual answer review.
scope.temporal_scope: Dated claims are scoped to their retained announcements. No guessed source date filters, present-day availability or price guarantees are encoded.
scope.retrieval_metrics: Report top-5 source-document relevance and literal supporting-anchor hits separately, with language/domain/answerability slices. A document hit is not a supporting-span hit. Neither is a complete research-answer evaluation.
scope.public_contents: Original questions, concise factual expectations, stable IDs, hashes and short literal anchors only. Raw documents, long passages, machine paths and private logs are excluded.

limits: Known relevant sources are not exhaustive judgments; this development set is not a held-out accuracy estimate.
Relevant context for an unsupported question is not evidence of a supported answer or safe abstention.
Literal anchor hit and exact coordinates do not prove semantic entailment or current suitability.
No generated recommendation or audiovisual understanding was scored by this runner.

baseline.scope: Original retained old-extraction/index baseline; extraction and ranking both differ from v2. Gold uses recovered v2 sources. Whitespace-only source wrapping is normalized for literal anchors.

architecture_decision.reason: 39/40 known-source hits and 26/40 any-anchor hits; optional semantic31/19 and hybrid36/26. Small pilot did not generalize. This is a fixed development set, not universal accuracy.
